I Miss the Stock Android User Experience. While it's a nice phone with good features, such as a beautiful display and great camera, the Samsung user experience is different than the standard Android experience. The keyboard, for example, is different and takes some getting time to adjust to its layout. ... I don't even see the need for Bixby and the Bixby button is always getting in the way. The fingerprint reader is hit-or-miss, as is the facial recognition. I replaced an Essential PH1 with this phone and was expecting a vast improvement, as this was the recent Samsung flagship and I had bought into the hype. But the user interface had me missing the Essential PH1 on more than a few occasions.

Good phone, for a while.. I got this phone for my wife, it was the highest performance phone she had ever had. I have the S9, and have no complaints, so I got her the next model since it has been about 2.5 years since getting mine. Well, it ran really well. Did all her games, texting, facebook, video chats, websurfing, pictures, etc... really well. Until one evening she was watching a streaming movie, and when she quit watching and picked the phone up, the bottom inch or so of the screen went pure white. The screen still responded to touch, but nothing was visible within that white band. The phone started being weird about sending and recieving messages, slow performance, short battery life, heating up, and very slow charging (if it would charge at all). So, I will be returning it. I really wish it had worked out.

Great photos, horrible user experience. I did not buy this from Amazon in all fairness, but I use Amazon for a lot of my purchases so I figured I'd post my review here. As a longtime android user (10 years), mostly with nexus devices, I can honestly say this phone was the worst user experience I've had in the android ecosystem. Issues with the fingerprint reader and Samsung constantly prompting me to use their apps for standard Google services soured me quickly. The only positive I can say for this phone is the camera and video capabilities. This phone killed android for me after 6 months of ownership and I replaced it with an apple 11 pro max. I never thought I would leave the android ecosystem, but the poor user experience sealed the deal.

The screen quality is awesome as well and you can change the settings to make it over over top crystal clear or a Lil less so to save battery life. 06_rerank.text: Team Samsung Galaxy!. A natural upgrade from my galaxy s8 which served me well but had to retire due to an excessively cracked screen. Very reliable phones however, haven't had an issue with their build quality or performance yet! Keep up the good work!

As for the performance of the S10, I'm quite sure I could get at least 1 day of use of this phone if I lowered my usage a bit and used the screen at the 1080p or 720p resolution. After the recent Android 10 update, which gave this lineup of phones many more features that can also be found on the new S20 lineup, I'd say you should also consider this phone, as on average, these will be around $200-400 less than its younger counterpart and you will recieve similar features. One last thing to note, however, (and maybe this is just me incorrectly using the phone) is that the fingerprint reader usually takes a good bit to read (about 3 seconds for me, which is a lot more than what I'm used to from my S8) and semi-frequently fails to read my print at all.

Overall a good phone, Screen protectors can be hard to find. Arrived exactly as promised.. I use this phone everyday, for hours on end. The processing speed is really fast, and the battery life is impressive given that I'm on my phone so much. It also has a lot of space and takes pictures well. My one complaint is it's hard to take pictures with the front facing camera or replace the screen protector because screen protectors that work with the fingerprint sensor are hard to find and expensive. The phone came exactly as promised though, and it was in great working condition, so if you're looking for a galaxy s10 I would absolutely recommend this seller.

After the recent Android 10 update, which gave this lineup of phones many more features that can also be found on the new S20 lineup, I'd say you should also consider this phone, as on average, these will be around $200-400 less than its younger counterpart and you will recieve similar features. One last thing to note, however, (and maybe this is just me incorrectly using the phone) is that the fingerprint reader usually takes a good bit to read (about 3 seconds for me, which is a lot more than what I'm used to from my S8) and semi-frequently fails to read my print at all.

Overall a good phone, Screen protectors can be hard to find. Arrived exactly as promised.. I use this phone everyday, for hours on end. The processing speed is really fast, and the battery life is impressive given that I'm on my phone so much. It also has a lot of space and takes pictures well. My one complaint is it's hard to take pictures with the front facing camera or replace the screen protector because screen protectors that work with the fingerprint sensor are hard to find and expensive. The phone came exactly as promised though, and it was in great working condition, so if you're looking for a galaxy s10 I would absolutely recommend this seller.

Good phone, for a while.. I got this phone for my wife, it was the highest performance phone she had ever had. I have the S9, and have no complaints, so I got her the next model since it has been about 2.5 years since getting mine. Well, it ran really well. Did all her games, texting, facebook, video chats, websurfing, pictures, etc... really well. Until one evening she was watching a streaming movie, and when she quit watching and picked the phone up, the bottom inch or so of the screen went pure white. The screen still responded to touch, but nothing was visible within that white band. The phone started being weird about sending and recieving messages, slow performance, short battery life, heating up, and very slow charging (if it would charge at all). So, I will be returning it. I really wish it had worked out.

Worth every penny.. For the price, Excellent condition. Minor scratches on the screen but with the screen protector, you can't even tell. I think they might of tested the water resistance because the phone was a little damp when I received it(USB port). But great performance, and very fast overall. Very much of what I was expecting and more!

Good phone. Everything is great about the phone if you're a regular Samsung user. I went from a Galaxy S7 to this S10 and have seen a noticeable difference in performance. The only thing I'm bummed about is a close-up picture setting that was on the S7 but not on the S10. Despite that, the camera is of excellent quality and has a fast response.

Best phone available!. I just got this phone yesterday and so far it is an amazing phone! Great performance and beautiful screen! Upgraded from a Galaxy S8 and so far I'd say that it a really good upgrade! The fingerprint sensor in the screen is great and works well.

Great Buy. I upgraded my phone from S7 mostly due to the depleting battery life. I do not regret my decision. For general use, a charge lasts for a whole day. The performance is a lot better as well. The downside of the phone is that is the sides of the screen. When I hold the phone, it sometimes take unnecessary actions. I had some difficulty using one hand. Overall, it is a great buy.

Screen and Preformance are great. I love the resolution. I love the amount of storage I get with it alongside the increase in ram. Looks beautiful and truly allows you to appreciate its curves and sleekness. I upgraded from an s8 and it was worth the purchase. The screen is better than most of the new phones out there.

Worse buy ever. I loved this phone and the performance was great. But I notice some flaws from day one when I purchased it. The speaker sounded muffled, the screen had burn in when I got it and it supposed to be brand new and the charger set was generic. I wouldn't recommend this at all to anyone

Nice phone. Pros: Resolution, Camera, User friendly interface, Handy & fast. Cons: Battery life, Fingerprint sensor is not working when you add a screen protector(may be due to thinkness of the protector).
Good Product. Great Condition. As good as new.. Exceeded my expectations. Scratchless. Good Display, Battery life and performance. Worth every penny.

Galaxy s10 128 gig top quality like new thank you. Thank you for the Samsung Galaxy S10 I read some reviews and I guess they where from a while back but this company has it together I received a quality product activated service today through Verizon and I have had it around 5 days seems to be functioning at peak performance I did select Verizon carrier the phone is a sprint phone but no problems if your hesitant or over thinking it don't good quality company ill use them again thank you again
Love it!. Screen looks amazing, the back is super shinny! And the camera is the best quality I've ever had
Almost new. Great phone! I bought 2 and love the quality and performance.

I Miss the Stock Android User Experience. While it's a nice phone with good features, such as a beautiful display and great camera, the Samsung user experience is different than the standard Android experience. The keyboard, for example, is different and takes some getting time to adjust to its layout. ... I don't even see the need for Bixby and the Bixby button is always getting in the way. The fingerprint reader is hit-or-miss, as is the facial recognition. I replaced an Essential PH1 with this phone and was expecting a vast improvement, as this was the recent Samsung flagship and I had bought into the hype. But the user interface had me missing the Essential PH1 on more than a few occasions.

Great phone dude below is probably a iPhone user. Amazing phone awesome cameras great display finger print scanner is fast once you get used to it love the phone don't listen to the guy below he has 10e and is nit picking and audio quality is fine I'm coming form a note 9

The screen quality is awesome as well and you can change the settings to make it over over top crystal clear or a Lil less so to save battery life. The sound is really good I used to think I had a bad aux cord in the work truck or at least the sound system was weak but now that I'm using this phone for Spotify at work it's crisp and clear I am very pleased with this purchase I'd say for the price it was more then worth it
Best galaxy option in the market today. Like hd screen quality and battery life

Did come with a few scratches on the corners of the phone, but did exceed expectations overall.. [[VIDEOID:8b2493e4d3a43115cefb0f9f4ece8be1]] Face recognition is fast but the fingerprint reader is preferred. Battery life is good, if your a heavy smartphone user then the battery might last you a full day. The speakers are very good, you can make them louder with Dolby Atmos. Camera quality is amazing! it can record up to 4k 60fps and the images turn out very vivid and clear. Overall amazing phone!
